title: Special Topics in News Writing and Reporting; Product Development
description:
Prerequisite: JOUR320 or JOUR360. Alternating face-to-face/online class meeting. See instructor for details.

Students will learn how to approach news publications as products that can be assessed and continually improved to meet changing audience needs and ensure support for their organization. We'll cover product and design thinking frameworks and business fundamentals - culminating in team-based projects to help existing and new news projects serve their audiences and meet their strategic goals.
